CRM.rationale: Salesforce presents a moderately attractive setup combining improving fundamentals with significant valuation compression. The business exhibits textbook SaaS operating leverage: Q2 FY26 revenue grew +4.1% QoQ to $10.24B while operating income surged +20.1% QoQ and EPS diluted +23.3% QoQ, with operating margin reaching 22.8% — the highest in the available 3-quarter window. The balance sheet is fortress-grade with $61.3B equity against $8.44B debt (D/E 0.138). Full-year FY26 revenue of $41.5B (up 10% YoY) and FY27 guidance of $45.8B confirm sustained double-digit growth on a $40B+ base. Agentforce ARR surpassed $500M (up 330% YoY) with 18,500 deals closed, representing a credible AI monetization pivot. Valuation has compressed meaningfully: trailing PE at 37.0x is at the floor of its 1-year range (34.6–61.1), while forward P/E of ~19.9x (based on FY27 consensus) and P/B at 2.91x (range 2.7–4.8) suggest the market is pricing in significant disruption risk. The stock has declined ~33% from $264.81 to $176.53 while fundamentals improved — a hallmark of multiple compression rather than fundamental deterioration. Near-term catalysts include the $50B buyback authorization with $25B accelerated share repurchase already underway, and Q1 FY27 earnings (consensus $2.30 EPS, +18.6% YoY) which could re-rate the stock if the margin expansion trajectory continues. Key risks temper conviction: OCF volatility ($740M in Q2 vs $6.48B in Q1) raises cash-earnings conversion questions, only 3 quarters of data are available in the quant window preventing YoY trend confirmation, the macro backdrop (4.4% 10-year, 6.1% Baa spreads) may cap multiple re-expansion, and the structural question of whether AI-agent consumption revenue will fully replace per-seat pricing remains unanswered. The score of +0.35 reflects a solid fundamental franchise with improving trajectory and meaningful valuation discount, partially offset by OCF uncertainty and the AI transition risk, with a modest catalyst boost from the buyback and upcoming earnings.
